# Saddlewood Contracting LLC
> Residential builder in Scottsdale, Arizona (since 2013). Luxury remodeling, new
> construction, and structural framing as a subcontractor for builders and GCs
> (wood + steel, slab to trusses, self-performed). AZ ROC #305762.
